 News › News News › Chhath Puja school holiday, November 16: Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand schools to remain closed; Check sta… Chhath Puja school holiday, November 16: Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand schools to remain closed; Check state-wise list
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 22:23 IST All Delhi schools to remain closed on Monday, November 16 due to Chhath Pujaa festival Students in Delhi got a long weekend as the capital’s schools stay closed on Monday, November 16, for the concluding day of Chhath Puja. Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand are also on break, though the dates differ from state to state.
 Delhi schools will remain closed on November 16 under a circular issued by the Directorate of Education, which covers both government and private schools. The Delhi government declared the day a public holiday for Pratihar Shashthi, also called Surya Shashthi, after the Lieutenant Governor approved the move. The General Administration Department issued the notification on November 9.
 The break comes as the four-day festival draws to a close. Chhath Puja is celebrated from November 13 to 16 this year, mainly in eastern Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand and Bihar. 
 The rituals began on Friday, November 13, with Nahay Khay. The holiday falls on the final day, when devotees offer prayers to the rising Sun. Because the festival overlaps with the weekend, many parents were waiting to confirm whether Monday would be a school day.
 State-wise list 
 Delhi: The capital’s schools and colleges will be closed on Monday. 
 Bihar: Government and government-aided schools will stay closed from November 7 to 17, under the state’s 2026 academic calendar, and will reopen on November 18. Bihar’s break is the longest because Chhath is the state’s biggest festival. 
 Jharkhand: Reports differ on the exact dates. One state-wise list shows that schools remain closed from November 13 to 16, 2026. Another report says the holiday will run for three days, on November 15, 16 and 17. Parents should check the circular from their child’s school.
 Uttar Pradesh: Reports say the state calendar has a holiday on November 15 and 16. Another says a separate statewide notification was not confirmed, and that districts where the festival is widely celebrated may announce local holidays. 
 Assam: Schools were scheduled to be closed on November 15 for Chhath Puja.
 West Bengal: Schools are likely to remain closed from November 16 to 20 for Jagadhatri Puja, which is widely celebrated in Chandannagar and Krishnanagar . 
 Chhath Puja School Holiday - What parents should do 
 Holiday calendars vary across states, between government and private schools, and sometimes between districts. Reports also differ on some dates, notably in Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh. 
 Parents are advised to check the latest circular from their child's school or district education office before Monday, since local orders can change at short notice.
 For Delhi, the notification for government offices, autonomous bodies and PSUs is separate from the Directorate of Education circular for schools. All Delhi schools shall remain closed on November 16 in lieu of Chhath Puja. Classes will resume in Delhi on Tuesday, November 17, while students in Bihar return on Wednesday, November 18.
